name: label
summary: Rename things as the hand Labeller does: one with reference_id and name, or up to 64 with labels. An empty name gives back the game's name for it.

help.text: Uses the game's own rename: the host's rename syncs to clients and is saved; a multiplayer client sends it to the host. Each result gives written, sent_to_host, previous and current {display_name, custom_name}, read back from the thing.

names.text: As the Labeller writes it: an empty name becomes the game's name for the prefab (stored as that name, not cleared), cut to 200 characters, rich-text tags stripped except on signs and labels.

refusals.text: not_labelable: a class the Labeller cannot rename: pipes, cables, frames, ordinary items, and the pipe-size in-line tanks (StructureInLineTankGas1x2 and the like); the game has no rename for them. Label a sign or device beside one instead. It renames portable tanks and other movable things, every device, the big in-line tanks (StructureInLineTank), hydroponic trays, plants, IC chips and flags; find_things reports labelable. A refusal changes nothing; in the batch form only its own entry fails.

reference_id.description: The thing to rename (find_things, looking_at, list_devices).

name.description: The new name; empty gives back the game's name.

labels.description: Several renames, up to 64, applied in order; instead of reference_id and name.
